claims.claim_text: Folklorist Nancy Sweezy, born Nancy Thompson, is a plausible but unconfirmed candidate for the indexed Nancy Thompson.
claims.evidence_excerpt: During World War II, she worked overseas in the Research and Analysis Branch
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A New York Times obituary reports Nancy Sweezy's Thompson birth name and OSS work; the Library of Congress and her daughter's obituary independently document her overseas OSS analytical work and art-school study.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Ambiguous: the exact birth name and OSS context agree, but the common-name index row has no rank, protected identifier, birth data, assignment or Box 775 selector to supply the required second corroborating identifier.
claims.temporal_assessment: The candidate sources document School of the Museum of Fine Arts study before OSS work, but none of that chronology may be transferred to the indexed row until identity is resolved.
claims.match_notes: The candidate and possible Nancy Adams and Nancy Sweezy variants remain private review leads. No employer or student affiliation is published for the indexed person.
